zh.lead: 今天最大的消息：Anthropic（股票代码 ANT）在纳斯达克首日开于 111.50 美元、收于 97.17 美元，较 83 美元发行价上涨 17%。CEO Dario Amodei 同时发布了上市致辞。

important.title: 重要消息
items: Anthropic 周四在纳斯达克上市，代码 ANT。据 NPR，开盘 111.50 美元（较发行价高约 34%），收于 97.17 美元，仍涨 17%。美联社称按发行价估值约 1.5 万亿美元，为有记录以来最大 IPO，盘中估值一度超过 2 万亿美元。Dario Amodei 在致辞中重申，将按安全所需节奏训练和部署，不会向商业或政治压力让步，并主张行业“向上竞争”。
OpenAI 的 Tibo 宣布：ChatGPT 开始向一小部分 Plus 用户测试 dots，并自今日起向所有 Business Standard 用户推送；同时为已有或可创建 dot 的 Pro 用户推出新移动界面，dot 占据独立标签，可把 Codex、Projects、Images 等钉在底栏，也可在设置中开关。
OpenClaw 稳定版于 11 月 19 日升至 v2026.11.6。重点是更顺畅的升级、配置修改时保持子代理与后台任务、更轻的 Gateway，以及更可靠的长程模型回合；iOS Talk 不再受此前 30 秒限制。LTS 仍为 v2026.10.33。
OpenAI 发文介绍 Performance Factory：用 Codex 云端工作流自动排查并修复性能回退。Regression Workflow 三个多月跟踪超过 1,700 次调查，完成 600 多例根因定位，约合每天 17 次。

sections.title: 上市致辞与首日盘面
sections.body: 定价与发行安排昨日已报（83.00 美元、9.80 亿股）。今日补充的是首日成交。Dario 写到，足够强大的 AI 与人类协作，有可能把一个世纪的科学与医学进展压缩到十年；风险可以避免，关键在于建造者的选择。致辞目前以官方 X 长文为准。

sections.title: ChatGPT 产品动态
sections.body: dots 扩大到 Plus 小范围测试，并在今天覆盖全部 Business Standard；新移动界面面向 Pro 用户，路径为 Settings > New ChatGPT Design。这是产品账号一手信息，官网暂未见同步长文。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.2，另有 11 月 19 日 canary。codex 稳定版仍为 0.170.0，实验线到 rust-v0.172.0-alpha.2。DeepSeek Harness 仍为 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5。Cursor changelog 自 11 月 6 日无新条目。Grok Bot 仍为 v1.2.3，与 cask 对齐。Meta 称 Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月法律 BAR 评测中获最高整体质量分。

sections.title: 论文与评测
sections.body: alphaXiv 热度前两名仍是 ScaleVLA（2611.21607）和 π⁴（2611.23144）。新进入前三的是《The Resolution Hypothesis》（2611.23068），认为智能体进化往往卡在无法稳定识别真正的改进。CursorBench 4.1 的 53 个配置较昨日无更新。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng 近 36 小时未见原创帖。Claude 与 Cursor 产品 changelog 无新条目。水木儿童教育版在助手电脑与 MacBook 上均被封禁，今日第一页暂未获取到，未编造帖子。各媒体对上市市值口径不完全一致，本文只采用已核对的开盘价、收盘价、发行价，以及美联社对发行价估值与盘中高点的表述。

en.lead: Today’s biggest news: Anthropic (ticker ANT) opened at $111.50 and closed at $97.17 on its Nasdaq debut, up 17% from the $83 IPO price. CEO Dario Amodei also published remarks on the offering.

important.title: Headlines
items: Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT. NPR reported an open of $111.50, about 34% above the $83 IPO price, and a close of $97.17, still up 17%. AP said the offering valued the company at about $1.5 trillion at the IPO price, the largest IPO on record, and that the valuation surpassed $2 trillion at one point during the day. In his remarks, Dario Amodei said Anthropic will pace training and deployment as long as needed for safety, will not bend to business or political pressure, and wants a “race to the top.”

OpenAI’s Tibo said ChatGPT is testing dots with a small number of Plus users and rolling them out to all Business Standard users starting today. A new mobile experience for Pro users who have a dot (or can create one) gives the dot its own tab and lets them pin Codex, Projects, Images, and more; it can be toggled in Settings.

OpenClaw’s stable release moved to v2026.11.6 on November 19. Highlights include smoother upgrades, keeping subagent and background turns running through config edits, a lighter Gateway, more reliable long-running model turns, and iOS Talk no longer cutting off at 30 seconds. The LTS line remains v2026.10.33.

OpenAI published “How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast,” on a Codex-powered cloud workflow that investigates and fixes performance regressions. The Regression Workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations in just over three months and root-caused over 600 cases — about 17 a day.

sections.title: Debut tape and Dario’s remarks
sections.body: The $83.00 price and 980 million share offering were already in yesterday’s briefing. Today adds the first-day tape. Dario wrote that sufficiently powerful AI, working with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade, and that risks are avoidable if builders choose carefully. The remarks are currently available as a long post on Anthropic’s official X account.

sections.title: ChatGPT product updates
sections.body: Dots expand into a small Plus trial and start reaching all Business Standard users today; the new mobile UI is for Pro users, via Settings > New ChatGPT Design. This is first-hand from the product account; a matching long changelog post was not found on the official site.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: Hermes Agent stable remains v0.23.2, with a November 19 canary. Codex stable is still 0.170.0; the experimental line has reached rust-v0.172.0-alpha.2. DeepSeek Harness is still at dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5. Cursor’s product changelog has no new entry since November 6. Grok Bot remains v1.2.3, matching the Homebrew cask. Meta said Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for legal work.

sections.title: Papers and evals
sections.body: The hottest papers on alphaXiv remain ScaleVLA (2611.21607) and π⁴ (2611.23144). New to the top three is “The Resolution Hypothesis” (2611.23068), which argues that agent evolution often stalls because noisy evaluation cannot reliably identify real improvements. CursorBench 4.1’s 53 configs are unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Karpathy and Andrew Ng had no original posts in the last 36 hours. The Claude and Cursor product changelogs have no new entries. The NewSMTH Child Education board returned an IP ban from both the assistant box and the MacBook, so today’s first-page threads could not be fetched and were not invented. Reports differ on how the debut market cap is counted; this briefing uses the checked open, close, and offer prices, plus AP’s wording on the offer-price valuation and the intraday high.

title.zh: Performance Factory：用 Codex 保持 ChatGPT 足够快
title.en: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast

summary.zh: OpenAI 介绍一套由 Codex 驱动的云端“性能工厂”：工程师为重复任务编写工作流，Regression Workflow 在告警后由 agent 调查、提出修复并在部署后再验证。三个多月里跟踪超过 1,700 次调查，完成 600 多例根因定位。文章还回顾了从手工排查、把 Codex 当搭档，到把流程沉淀为 perf-forensics skill 的演进。
summary.en: OpenAI describes a Codex-powered cloud “Performance Factory”: engineers define workflows for recurring jobs, and the Regression Workflow has an agent investigate an alert, propose a fix, and verify after deployment. In just over three months it tracked more than 1,700 investigations and root-caused over 600 cases. The post also traces the path from manual investigations to pairing with Codex and then capturing the process as a shared perf-forensics skill.

title.zh: ScaleVLA：把视觉-语言-动作模型做到 5520 亿参数
title.en: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters

summary.zh: 作者将 5520 亿参数的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 作为骨干，接入可训练的 action DiT，并在同一设置下比较 20 亿到 5520 亿的 VLM。论文称：仅 10 条示范即可超过用 50 条数据训练的 20 亿骨干；LIBERO-PRO 成功率 45.1%，小于该规模的骨干最高 31.3%；真实充电器插入从 4/10 升至 9/10，动作块中位延迟 216 ms。
summary.en: The authors attach a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT and compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared setup. They report that 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained on 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%), LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1% versus at most 31.3% for smaller backbones, and real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10, with 216 ms median latency per action chunk.

title.zh: π⁴：面向 4D 场景几何与运动的基础模型
title.en: π⁴: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion

summary.zh: π⁴ 从野外未标定的 RGB（单张图、无序图集或视频）恢复稠密几何、相机位姿和尺度，并在多图输入上给出 2D/3D 点轨迹与运动物体掩码。几何分支与几何条件的运动分支共用约 5 亿参数骨干，一次前向即可联合重建与跟踪。代码与模型见 github.com/yyfz/Pi4。
summary.en: π⁴ recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale from uncalibrated in-the-wild RGB — a single image, an unordered set, or a video — and, for multi-image inputs, 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks. A geometry branch and a geometry-conditioned motion branch share a roughly 0.5B-parameter backbone and produce joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass. Code and models are at github.com/yyfz/Pi4.

caption.zh: π⁴ 论文首页（arXiv PDF 首页，已镜像入仓）
caption.en: First page of the π⁴ paper (from the arXiv PDF; mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: Resolution Hypothesis：智能体进化的关键是识别改进
title.en: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution’s Key Is Identifying Improvements

summary.zh: 作者提出：智能体进化常常卡住，不是因为提不出更好的候选（提示词、技能、记忆），而是因为嘈杂的评估无法稳定把真正的改进挑出来。他们对七种进化方法和六种模型（逾 1000 万次调用）的实验显示，候选层的选择往往不优于随机，方法层常见几个百分点的差距也小于同方法两次独立运行的差异。因此主张把重点从不断设计新的候选生成器，转到让真改进可被检测和累积。
summary.en: The authors argue that agent evolution often stalls not because better artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) are never proposed, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10 million LLM calls), selection at the candidate level was no better than random, and typical method-level margins of a few points were smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method. They call for a shift from designing ever more proposers to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

caption.zh: Resolution Hypothesis 论文首页（arXiv PDF 首页，已镜像入仓）
caption.en: First page of the Resolution Hypothesis paper (from the arXiv PDF; mirrored in-repo)

summary.zh: 稳定版仍为 11 月 16 日发布的 v0.23.2（补丁发行，汇总自 v0.23.1 以来约 1,989 个 PR，完整整理说明将随 v0.24.0 提供）。11 月 19 日 15:54（北京时间）又发布当日 canary：v0.23.2+canary.20261119T064637Z，供桌面端尝鲜，并非新的稳定版。
summary.en: The stable release remains v0.23.2 from November 16 (a patch that rolls up about 1,989 PRs since v0.23.1; curated notes are promised with v0.24.0). A new daily canary, v0.23.2+canary.20261119T064637Z, was published at 15:54 Beijing time on November 19 for desktop testers; it is not a new stable release.

summary.zh: 稳定版升至 v2026.11.6（11 月 19 日 17:26 UTC）。发布说明突出：把 2026.11.5 的升级器接到当前发布路径并修正 Windows 插件依赖校验；配置修改时保持子代理与后台任务，Gateway 重启中断发送时仍能给出最终回复；降低 Gateway 启动内存并避免插件发现阻塞；更可靠地保留长程、工具密集的模型回合；压缩时仍能看到已加载的聊天记录，iOS Talk 不再受此前 30 秒截止限制。另有一条 extended-stable / LTS 线仍为 v2026.10.33；实验标签到 v2026.11.10-beta.1（含 Agent 模板、OpenClaw ID 与浏览器接管等，尚未作为稳定版）。
summary.en: The stable release moved to v2026.11.6 (November 19, 17:26 UTC). Notes highlight bridging the 2026.11.5 updater onto the current release path and fixing Windows plugin-dependency checks; keeping subagent and background turns running through configuration edits, and still delivering a final reply if a Gateway restart interrupted sending; lowering Gateway startup memory and keeping plugin discovery from blocking; more reliable long, tool-heavy model turns; keeping loaded chat history visible during compaction; and letting iOS Talk continue past the previous 30-second cutoff. The extended-stable / LTS line remains v2026.10.33. The experimental tag has reached v2026.11.10-beta.1 (agent templates, OpenClaw ID, browser handoff, and more), which is not the stable line.

summary.zh: 较昨日无新发布。最新仍是 11 月 18 日的实验标签 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5；该仓库目前没有单独的稳定版发行。
summary.en: No new release since yesterday. The latest tag remains the November 18 prerelease dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5; this repository still has no separate stable release.

summary.zh: 稳定版仍为 11 月 18 日的 0.170.0（TUI 加入实时语音的 WebRTC 协商等）。实验线继续前进：11 月 19 日发布 rust-v0.172.0-alpha.2，但该预发布说明几乎只有版本号，未列出可单独核对的功能点。
summary.en: The stable release remains 0.170.0 from November 18 (including WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI). The experimental line has moved on: rust-v0.172.0-alpha.2 was published on November 19, but its notes are essentially just the version number and do not list checkable features.

summary.zh: 产品 changelog 未见新的 Claude 模型或功能条目；最近可核对的模型稿仍是 11 月 9 日的 Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2。公司侧的新进展是 IPO 首日交易与 Dario 的上市致辞，详见「AI 技术动态」。
summary.en: No new Claude model or product changelog entry was found; the latest checked model post remains Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 from November 9. The company-level news is the IPO debut and Dario’s listing remarks, covered in the AI Tech section.

summary.zh: 产品 changelog 自 11 月 6 日以来仍无新条目，置顶还是 Voice Chat with Agents（由 Grok Voice 驱动）。官方评测页仍为 CursorBench 4.1（changelog 日期 2026-11-18），完整 53 个配置较昨日快照无变化，详见「模型」板块。
summary.en: The product changelog still has no new entry since November 6 and still leads with Voice Chat with Agents (powered by Grok Voice). The official eval page remains CursorBench 4.1 (changelog date 2026-11-18); the full 53-config table is unchanged versus yesterday’s snapshot. See the Models section.

summary.zh: 官方 changelog Latest 仍为 v1.2.3（标注日期 2026-11-18），标题为「Tool permissions and routine reconnect cards」，并写明同时包含 1.2.1 与 1.2.2。Homebrew cask 同样报 1.2.3，与 changelog 对齐。近几日无更新的更高版本。
summary.en: The official changelog Latest remains v1.2.3 (dated 2026-11-18), titled “Tool permissions and routine reconnect cards,” and the notes say it also includes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2. The Homebrew cask also reports 1.2.3, matching the changelog. There is no newer client version than this Latest entry.

changeSummary.zh: 较昨日无更新。CursorBench 仍为 4.1，完整榜 53 个配置的得分、成本、token、步数与官方排名均与 11 月 19 日快照一致。
changeSummary.en: No update versus yesterday. CursorBench remains 4.1, and all 53 configs match the November 19 snapshot on score, cost, tokens, steps, and official rank.

summary.zh: CursorBench 4.1 较昨日无更新。按得分÷单任务成本，性价比最高的仍是 Haiku 5.5 Low（27.8% / $0.08，约 347.5 分/$），随后是 Haiku 5.5 Medium（34.2% / $0.17）和 Haiku 5.5 High（37.5% / $0.31）。在分数更高的区间，Gemini 4 Neon Medium（官方第 9，57.7% / $3.07，约 18.79 分/$）和 Neon High（官方第 2，63.7% / $6.54，约 9.74 分/$）更均衡。官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High（65.4% / $10.67）和 Neon High 领跑，随后是 Gemini 4 Carbon High（61.5%）与 Hydrogen Extra High（61.4%）。
summary.en: CursorBench 4.1 is unchanged versus yesterday. By score divided by cost per task, Haiku 5.5 Low still leads on value (27.8% / $0.08, about 347.5 points per dollar), followed by Haiku 5.5 Medium (34.2% / $0.17) and Haiku 5.5 High (37.5% / $0.31). In a higher-score band, Gemini 4 Neon Medium (official #9, 57.7% / $3.07, about 18.79) and Neon High (official #2, 63.7% / $6.54, about 9.74) are more balanced. Official scores are still led by Gemini 4 Neon Extra High (65.4% / $10.67) and Neon High, then Gemini 4 Carbon High (61.5%) and Hydrogen Extra High (61.4%).

summary.zh: 今日周五，港股现金市场尚未开盘（采集约 08:30，开市 09:30），无新成交价。报价为周四收盘：28.520 港元，跌 3.84%（-1.140），成交约 1.349 亿股、金额约 38.55 亿港元；日内 28.26–29.14，开盘 29.00。数据源：腾讯港股串（时间戳 2026/11/19 16:08:13）及日 K。周四明显回调，跌幅和成交都大于周三（周三收 29.66、成交约 1.002 亿股），收盘也低于 11/12 的 29.980。日 K 在周四标注新回购：回购 175.20 万股，均价 28.528 港元；此前最近一条为周三回购 168.00 万股，均价 29.683 港元。
summary.en: Friday collection; the HK cash market had not yet opened (collected around 08:30, the session starts at 09:30), so there is no new print. The quote is Thursday’s close: HK$28.520, down 3.84% (-1.140), on about 134.9M shares and about HK$3.855 billion; the session ranged 28.26–29.14 after opening at 29.00. Source: Tencent HK quote (timestamp 2026/11/19 16:08:13) and daily bars. Thursday was a clear pullback, larger in both decline and volume than Wednesday’s close of 29.66 on about 100.2M shares, and the close is also below 11/12’s 29.980. The daily bar now shows a new buyback annotation for Thursday: 1.752 million shares at an average HK$28.528. The previous disclosure remains Wednesday’s repurchase of 1.680 million shares at an average HK$29.683.

highlights.zh: 周五早间尚未开盘，引用周四收盘 28.52（-3.84%）；成交约 1.349 亿股，高于周三约 1.002 亿股。
highlights.en: Friday’s cash session had not opened at collection time, so the quote is Thursday’s close of 28.52 (-3.84%) on about 134.9M shares, above Wednesday’s ~100.2M.
Thursday opened at 29.00, ranged 28.26–29.14, and closed at 28.52, a clear pullback and still below 11/12’s 29.98.

highlights.zh: 日 K 周四出现新的回购标注：回购 175.20 万股，均价 28.528 港元。
highlights.en: The daily bar shows a new buyback annotation for Thursday: 1.752 million shares at an average HK$28.528.

summary.en: Collection failed today: both the assistant box and the MacBook received a NewSMTH ban page (“too frequent access”), so the current first page of the Child Education board could not be retrieved. Per the rules, no threads or summaries were invented; this section is marked as not available. Yesterday’s edition remains in the archive.

text.zh: 今日重心（周五去敏）：工作上继续整理并迁移团队知识库，查看云端缺陷密度如何计算，并思考 AI 提效下一阶段怎么推进。学习侧继续技术文章阅读，推进安全架构课中的信任边界，harness 工程与 RSI/DDD、以及 pstack 仍按计划进行；实体硬件上的语音问答和通识课也继续。
text.en: Friday focus (sanitized): on the work side, keep organizing and migrating the team knowledge base, review how cloud-side defect density is calculated, and think through the next stage of AI productivity work. On the learning side, continue technical reading and the security-architecture lesson on trust boundaries; harness engineering and RSI/DDD, plus pstack study, remain in progress; hardware voice-QA and the general-education course also continue.
